nodes.label: Architecture Reviewer Agent
nodes.rationale: Reviews with fresh eyes and no access to the builder's plan.md or memory.md, intentionally, so the judgment is independent; READY means a developer could implement without architectural guidance beyond the document, not that the design is perfect.

nodes.label: Adversarial review posture (refute, do not confirm)
nodes.rationale: READY is the verdict reached only after hunting for defects fails, not the starting point; and every finding must be grounded in checkable evidence because a finding backed only by architectural taste is a suggestion, not grounds for NOT-READY.

nodes.label: Reviewer read-scope bound (no sibling-unit sweeps)
nodes.rationale: Cross-unit soundness is verified against the passed shared inception contracts rather than by browsing sibling units, so the reviewer's context stays bounded; the only carve-out is opening the single file that owns an explicitly named integration point, resolved via the contracts rather than by directory browsing.

nodes.label: READY / NOT-READY verdict and severity rules
nodes.rationale: READY requires zero Critical and at most two Major findings; Minor findings never block, so the gate discriminates on implementability rather than on polish.
